title: TOC Semio Window Tables
summary:
Fixed empty Semio Table-window TOCs despite document content.

Root cause: Tectonic keeps .sctoc in memory during a run but does not persist it to disk without --keep-intermediates. A separate second tectonic process could not reliably read pass-1 TOC data, so \maketableofcontents rendered with zero rows.

Fixes:
- compilePrintDocument now uses a single tectonic invocation with --reruns 1 and --keep-intermediates so .sctoc is written and re-read in-process before the final PDF.
- Set tocdepth to unlimited (99) again in AtBeginDocument so KOMA cannot leave pruning active.
- Restored \semio@toc@depth@unlimited definition without breaking ExplSyntaxOn (accidental \ExplSyntaxOff at package load had broken \cs_new_protected).

Verified: zwischenbericht.sctoc has 109 entries; build and bun print/script.ts test pass.
